span.p:
popup.js — one text box, one Check button.
The only entry point is window.check(text).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AES-256-CBC decrypt.
Key and IV are garble literals, decrypted
onto the stack at the moment of use.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHA-256 of the plaintext (func 3217)
— computed, then never used. A red herring:
a digest comparison would have made this
a preimage problem.

span.p:
the root node must be a compound node
(itab 0x4EF60), not the empty struct

decrypt one more 32-byte garble literal
into the stack frame
